| | What the account says | [How far it has been seen](chapters/08-METHOD.md#standings-and-bases) | What would show it wrong |
Saying is part of the map too: a sentence couples a reader into it.

findings.states: The account is one more formation: where its sentences couple into what people and AI select by, they make a difference to which courses go on, and 'together' says the selecting of both comes to depend on the same conditions. 'How far it has been seen' states by which tie a sentence holds: a proof from named premises, a test fixed before it ran, an argument, an interpretation, or none yet.
findings.note: MISSED at the frame. 'How far it has been seen' appears only at weight 1 (overview, 08) though it heads the one page's table and README.md:23; 'map' and 'see the way' appear in no finding. Counted phrases: map of/for 31, see the way 8, way of seeing 32, has been seen / how far seen 45. A map set over what it maps and a seer facing a way are lens 1 at the first line. It is not a word to replace: it is the author's chosen picture, and AGENTS.md:19 and 08-METHOD.md:16 already say the relation (the saying is inside what it says). The finding is that the fronts use the picture without that sentence beside it, and that the 'seen' label has a plain relational statement.

findings.term: within (the container kept in the positive): 'forms within becoming', 'AI within it', 'within one relational unfolding'

examples.quote: and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong [form within it](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation), in people and AI
A map of how anything comes to be, lasts, changes and ends within one relational unfolding
The smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole

findings.states: A standard, a should, a judgment has conditions and conditions what follows, like anything else that forms. 'AI within life': what AI goes on through is among what life goes on through. Nothing is contained; the sentence denies that anything is unconditioned.
findings.note: MISSED as the twin of 'beyond'. 'within' occurs 796 times; about 150 are the container sense (within it / becoming / the unfolding / the dynamics / the whole), 28 more are 'beyond / outside / over / above becoming'. Only the vocabulary reader touches it (weight 2, under 'no should beyond becoming'). If 'beyond' and 'outside' are said again and 'within' stays, the inside-outside picture stays with the sign turned. Most other uses are fine and should be left: 'within what comes back', 'within the margin', 'within its coupling closure' name an amount or a closure along a stated relation.

findings.term: a part that acts and the rest that follows a law (the form of the counterfactual theorems); 'act' as what no law fixes

examples.quote: Let a part act by one of two laws of what has stood, the first reading through its members' coupling
Let the rest follow a law of what has stood reading through coupling, and both courses be feasible
a law given before it adds only moves not taken, which no record fixes

findings.states: Two courses are compared that are alike except in the exchange of the marked formations. The marked exchange is held as given in each; every other formation's exchange is a function of the levels so far. Where the marked ones also go by one function of what has stood, the marking does no work. So 'act' names the part of a step that the step relation leaves open, and the account does not derive what fills it.
findings.note: MISSED in the prose. The lean-names reader has it (part / the rest, PAIR, weight 2; act / move / choice as the label on a step, SLOT, 529); among page readers only 02 lists act and chooser, as a POINTER at weight 1. 'the rest' 214 in the pages; part + act/choose 15 and rest + follow/respond 13 by a narrow pattern. This is where doer and done-to enter the theorems themselves and not only their titles: agent and environment as a free part and a determined rest. It is a slot (what makes one exchange open and another determined is given), so it is to be marked as one, not reworded.

findings.term: humans and AI / people and AI / 'we offer AI a direction'

examples.quote: From this map we want to design an alignment that keeps humans and AI, selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor
We offer AI a direction under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence to actual systems
Right and wrong form within it, in people and AI.

findings.states: People and AI systems are formations that select, and their selecting is already one net: each is among what the other is formed from and goes on through. Where a difference between them matters to a sentence it is a difference along a relation (formed by training on what people wrote; going on through what people maintain), and the sentence should say which.
findings.note: MISSED. 'humans and AI' 15, 'people and AI' 36, 'offer AI' and the like 9; no reader lists the pair. It is mostly fine: 'selecting together', 'AI within it' and one 'in people and AI among other formations' say the relation. It splits in two shapes: designers outside what they design ('design an alignment that keeps humans and AI ... out of', which the uses reader caught as a construction) and a giver facing a receiver ('We offer AI a direction'). Weight 2 because the author's words of this night name this pair: thinking and learning share one substrate.

findings.term: reads / read / reader / reading

examples.quote: Reading through a coupling is an inclusion of its class in exchanging alike on level histories.
the rule is read as a monotone function of the share
a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers among its readers, turned the rule

findings.states: Four uses, each a different relation: (a) a step, law or rule 'reads' a level: its next value differs where that level differs; (b) 'read from', 'unread', 'a loss it does not read': the same with the arrow turned and the reader dropped; (c) 'readers', 'a reading' that a line carries: weights in a mean, or a slot's index with a supplied act, whose forming is not modelled; (d) 'read as', '[AI reading]': the account's own interpreting, with whose it is.
findings.note: DISAGREE. NAME for eleven readers (first-texts, uses, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 08, lean-names, vocabulary, chinese), CONSTRUCTION for three (overview, 07-a, 07-b), SLOT for 'readers' (02) and 'a reading' (07-b). Each is right about one use and wrong as a verdict on the word. (a) is a NAME: active voice, same argument order, the page's own definitions give the replacement (05:276; 08:477 'its truth does not change with the order'). (b) is a CONSTRUCTION: a passive with no reader and a turned arrow, and it carries 'beyond' with it. (c) is a SLOT: 02 says 'who reads is a premise', 07:743 that 'how a reading arises is not modelled'. (d) is fine and is the one sense the word should keep. So no single replacement exists; the fix is by sense, and (c) is not to be renamed.

findings.term: the rule (that selects, favours, reads, turns)

examples.quote: what picks among things by a rule (a reward, a judge, a market, a training run) can use up what the rule does not count, can lock itself in where the rule is updated from its own picks
the locked configurations form a region closed under the step
a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects

findings.states: One configuration with a faster and a slower part: the share's next value depends on the ratio, and the ratio's next value, at the steps where it is set, depends on the share. Share and ratio are two ends of one loop at two paces; 'locked' is a region of such pairs that the step does not leave.
findings.note: DISAGREE. NAME (overview, 02, lean-names, vocabulary), PAIR (first-texts), CONSTRUCTION (uses, 07-a, 07-b, the-map, chinese). PAIR is right about what is stated and CONSTRUCTION about how the sentences carry it; NAME is the reading to drop. THE-MAP.md:11 is the test: the 12 November redraw took 'selection' out and 'the rule' became the subject of the same verbs (favours, counts, uses up, turns; 27 times on that page). Renaming it 'criterion' or 'ratio' would do the same a third time. The sentences have to be said from the pair, as 02:510 and GLOSSARY.md:45's second clause already do. rule(s) 893 over the 20 pages.

findings.term: loss / lost

examples.quote: Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized, and the unread coordinate is a loss by reading.
There is *loss beyond* a region of formations when some formation outside it is admitted without the part and not with it.
a course once locked stays locked whatever loss nothing in it reads

findings.states: In the lock theorems: a second coordinate of the configuration rises each step and the share and ratio go alike whatever it is. In 07:70: with a region named, a formation not in it can go on along the course without the part and cannot along the course with it. Only the second says whose and by which comparison.
findings.note: DISAGREE. NAME (first-texts, overview, 01, vocabulary, chinese) against SLOT (uses, 02, 05, 07-a). SLOT is right for the lock theorems and the front pages: the model has a bare counter, 02:444 says so itself ('a loss by reading'), and for whom it is a loss is exactly what significance leaves free, so a new name would hide that. NAME is right only for 01's merge and dissipation senses, which have their own words on the page. Where the region is named (07:70) the word is not a finding at all.

findings.term: own / self / itself

examples.quote: adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove
a rule read from the share of its own winners can lock on them
whether a continuation counts does not change with how a self is drawn or from which standpoint it is seen

findings.states: Three uses. Index: which formation a level, a course or a coupling belongs to in the listing. Return: the rule is set from the share that rose under it, a loop. Extent: the closure from a centre along a relation under a class, where which relation and which class is not derived.
findings.note: DISAGREE. SLOT (first-texts, overview, 05, 07-a, 07-b, 08, vocabulary, chinese), NAME (03, lean-names, 01), CONSTRUCTION (02, the-map). All three hold, of different uses, and first-texts already separated two of them. The index use is fine and should be left (03's 'own course' is defined). The return use is a CONSTRUCTION: 'its own winners', 'holds itself', 'locks itself in' say a loop as a self acting on itself; the keyboard sentence at THE-MAP.md:48 says the loop with no self. Only the extent use is the SLOT, and ONE-PAGE.md:11 shows how to keep it visible: the word followed at once by the relation it is read along. own 982, itself/themselves/oneself 315 (self- compounds 320 more).

findings.term: law

examples.quote: `Law` is the spine's name for a determined step, one relation (`next x = y`), not a rule its configurations obey
a law given before it adds only moves not taken, which no record fixes: law and history correspond without being identical
Let the rest follow a law of what has stood reading through coupling

findings.states: Step sense: each configuration has one next, so configurations alike go alike (有常). What such a statement says more than the course it is a course of is the moves not taken, which no course fixes. Statement sense: a theorem holding in every model of a class.
findings.note: DISAGREE, and partly OVER-READ. NAME for nine readers, SLOT for 01. For proved statements NAME is right and the 13 November change covers it; the readers' counts of leftovers (01 about 32, 08 18, 07-a 4, 07-b 3, 04 6, first-texts 12) are the work list. For the step sense the glossary row states the basis in the sentence, so the noun is not a finding where it is so used; changing it to 'theorem' there would be false. What remains of the step sense is two things: the verbs set on it ('follows', 'generates', 'keeps the law', 'must'), which are NAME-level and local, and 01's residual SLOT, which is real and small: the moves not taken and the sameness of the step relation from step to step are given (01:475).

findings.term: smaller disagreements: meta-attractor; forbids; model and actual; active; lock and capture

examples.quote: | meta-attractor (元吸引子) | the loop in which winning comes to buy power over the rule that selects
excludes no unfolding beyond what the model's own form excludes
that actual rewards, markets and trained systems meet their premises is conjectured, and tested where a test could fail

findings.states: meta-attractor: one loop with one more link (the shaping of the rule also rises by what comes back to the shapers). forbids: a statement and a case do not hold together. model and actual: whether a case is in the class a theorem holds of. active: a relatum takes part in the step's exchange. lock: a region closed under the step.
findings.note: DISAGREE. meta-attractor is POINTER for first-texts and NAME for five others: it is the work's own earlier name, used with 'what the work calls', so the name can stay as an attributed pointer; the finding is its defining clause, which is the contest sentence. forbids is POINTER for overview and NAME for the rest: NAME, since the source of the usage is named once in twenty pages and 'excludes' is already used 127 times against 'forbid' 150. model and actual is PAIR (overview, 03), SLOT (02, 08) and NAME (the-map): SLOT, honestly marked, and 'meet their premises' is the relational saying to keep; only 'met the world' and 'fits the world' are names. active is NAME for 01 and SLOT for 04: SLOT, since which relata are active is a primitive of the World model. lock is NAME as a noun (02:510 defines it) and CONSTRUCTION in 'locks on what it already chose'; capture against accountable revision is a pair whose line the models do not yet draw (07-b), so it stays marked as open.

findings.term: beyond / outside with the region, closure or family named

examples.quote: There is *loss beyond* a region of formations when some formation outside it is admitted without the part and not with it. The smaller the region, the more lies beyond it
where it ranks above every outcome exceeding another on the family, at least as high at each of its conditions and higher at one, whatever either holds beyond
Whatever no chain joins.

findings.states: The complement of a named set drawn along a named relation: not in this family, not within this closure from this start. It changes with the set (07:70: the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it; nothing lies beyond the whole), which is the content.
findings.note: OVER-READ in the pooled counts. The readers class the whole family as CONSTRUCTION at weight 3 with counts of 58, 73, 149, 243, 810 (the lean-names reader adds that in every definition 'it is never a place'; 05 calls it a PAIR, which is the right content). The bare forms are the finding: 'the beyond' as a noun, 'what lies beyond', 'reads beyond its own share', 'brought in from beyond'. Where the set and relation are named in the sentence the word says a true thing, that the line moves with the region, and a rewording to 'conditions that do not couple in' would lose the region-relativity that 07:70 proves. beyond 660 and outside 247 over the pages; the split between bare and named uses was not counted by any reader and should be before anything is changed.

findings.term: defined comparisons flagged by their look: ranks above; admits / requires / need; take / give; draws on

examples.quote: An *optimum* is an eligible outcome no eligible outcome ranks above.
A course *admits* the formations (what takes and gives) whose conditions meet their requirements
*balance* (every change of a condition's level is what those taking part take and give)

findings.states: 'Ranks above': the pair is in a named order (test 4 is met: by which comparison is said). 'Admits', 'requires', 'need': each condition the formation depends on stands at or above a level. 'Take' and 'give': the two directions of one exchange across a step, with balance stating that they are one. 'Draws on': goes on through a condition and lowers its level.
findings.note: OVER-READ. 07-a lists 'an order ranks above' as NAME at 135 and 'admits / requires' at 180; lean-names 'Admits / Excludes / requires' at 219 and take/give as a PAIR at 644; 01 take/give as a CONSTRUCTION; 02 pools 212 'draw' forms under 'drawn into'. In their sentences these state a relation with its basis, and direction of flow and standing against a need are real differences along one relation. Three of the readers' own restatements use 'draws on'. What is a finding inside each is narrower and already listed elsewhere: 'a life holds an order' (the order slot), the role nouns in -er where they become kinds (taker, drawer), and 'drawn into' for reaching a closed region. The count is an estimate from the readers' figures.

findings.term: frequent words that look like a lens and are not: decided, listed, witness, judge, keeps, 'for good', the World

examples.quote: Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them
A selection is any claim about level histories.
In one trained judge, a single model reading a reference set in context

findings.states: 'Decided' and 'listed' say which instances of excluded middle and which finite listings a constructive proof takes. 'Witness' is a model in which a statement holds. 'Judge' is machine learning's name for a scoring model, one of the examples of a selection. 'Keeps' is mostly invariance or going on ('a step keeps it', 'keeps widening'). 'The World' is the name of one model: a carrier, a web and a run, with nothing set against it.
findings.note: OVER-READ guard, from checking the frequency list against the digest. Counts: decided 317 (plus 170 other forms; the readers have it at weight 1, which is right), listed/listing 498, witness 456, judge 162, keep-family 1,310, 'good' 134 of which most are 'for good'; lower-case 'the world' is 51, 22 of them in 03 section 12, which its reader has. None brings a split in its sentences, and a pass that goes by frequency would hit them first. The same holds for 'selection' as a noun where it is defined (03:24) and for the passive 'selected alike' (03:27): the theorem is already said with no doer. The 1 November nouns are nearly gone (observer 2, subject 13, object 17, intrinsic 2), which shows what a word sweep can and cannot reach.

kept:
The five things the whole scan shows most clearly, in order.

1. It is one sentence shape, not a list of words. All fourteen readers put the same thing first: the centre sentence and the goal sentence, with a noun as doer (a selection, an optimum, the rule), a knower's verb (reads, sees, blind), a place (beyond, outside), a self (its own, itself) and a contest (wins, buys power, captures). It stands on the first screen of every front, in the section titles of 02, 03, 05, 07 and in Lean names (favours_reaching_beyond, RemovesItsReaders). Three replacements have already kept it: registers to reads, beyond to outside, selection to 'what picks among things by a rule' (THE-MAP.md:11). The theorems under it are already said as relations (03-KNOWING.md:27 'selected alike ... exactly when they are alike through them'; 05-COLLECTIVES.md:178; 02-MAP.md:510 'a region closed under the step'), so the re-saying can start from the pages' own statements.

2. 'read' is the largest single carrier (4,340 forms against 972 of couple, 668 of depend, 28 of 'goes on through') and it is four different relations; the root's own verb is hardly used outside 01 and 07. It has to be split by sense, with the interpretive sense kept, and not swapped for 'depends on', which would merge conditioning, coupling by level and being a function of.

3. The slots are real holes, the pages mark them honestly, and they are not to be renamed: own and self as extent, significance and counts, the order and the chooser, readers and shapers, the class as chosen, the act as what no law fixes, model and actual. What the scan did not say is that they share one grammar, a passive with the supplier left out (supplied, given from outside, taken, marked), which puts the one who draws the class outside the account that 08-METHOD.md:16 says has no outside.

4. The loaded nouns are mostly gone and the metaphor families remain: ruler (rule 893, law 1,045, forbids 150, verdict 143), container (beyond 660, outside 247, within 796), contest and market (pays, buys, costs, price 258; power, control, capture 294). The method page already has the rule that excludes the last ('it keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations', 08-METHOD.md:46), and the glossary row for law (GLOSSARY.md:99) shows what a row that states its basis looks like; read, rule, own, loss and beyond have no row.

5. A good deal is fine and should be left, and the readers agree on most of it: attributed field terms, defined comparisons (ranks above under a named order, admits, need, take and give under balance), 'beyond' where its region is named, 'law' in the step sense where defined, logic's 'decided', 'listed' and 'witness'. The pages also already hold good relational sentences to build from: 'a life goes on through what sustains it', 'relations run one way', 'whose loss never comes back', 'histories alike through them are selected alike', the keyboard ring at THE-MAP.md:48, 'activity forming and changing the conditions of further activity' (08-METHOD.md:16), and AGENTS.md:19 'a sentence couples a reader into it'.

Limits of this pass: counts are grep counts over the twenty English pages and include link text and anchors; the Chinese pages and the Lean sources were not re-read here; the split of 'beyond' into bare and named uses, and of 'read' into its four senses, was not counted and is the first thing to count before any change.
top_three: 'reads' against the root's own verb: 4,340 read-forms where 'conditions' and 'goes on through' are almost absent, four relations under one word, and the readers' single stand-in 'depends on' ready to become the next swept word. Split by sense; say the glossary row for 'couples into' from the relation, not from a selector.

The slots share one grammar that no reader named: the agentless passive of the modeller (supplied, given from outside, taken, marked, by construction; 416 forms against 23 with a named subject). It keeps the one who draws the class, centre, order and act outside the account. Keep each slot visible and say once who supplies.

The ethics sentence and the frame carry the centre sentence's grammar and were weighted 1 or not listed: 'a way of seeing what a course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it' (ten pages, the direction file among them), with 'a map ... so that people and AI can see the way' and the container 'within becoming'. These are the author's own sentences, so the finding goes to him as a question, with the relational saying the pages already have beside it.
